meta.description: Anime tracker: lists, episode progress, and how many hours your backlog actually takes.

home.emptyText: No metadata loaded yet. Run {command} — it pulls titles from Jikan into the database.

title.episodesHint: Click a number to mark everything up to it. Click the last one again to unmark it.

myList.title: My list
myList.emptyText: Add titles with the “+ Add to list” button — they show up here, and whatever you are watching appears on the home page under “Continue watching”.
myList.tgText: The bot will message you when titles you're watching get new episodes.
myList.tgOpen: Open the bot and press Start
myList.guestEpisodesNudge: With an account you'd get this by email on release day

backlog.title: How much time I have
backlog.intro: A watchlist is hours, not rows. Here you see what it adds up to, and what you can realistically finish tonight.
backlog.whatFitsNote: Started titles come first — finishing beats starting something new.
backlog.nothingFits: Nothing in your list fits into {time}.
backlog.emptyText: Your list is empty, nothing to count.
backlog.estimatedHint: Duration unknown, using a typical value
backlog.supportHint: Did the math save you an evening?

auth.signInIntro: Needed to keep your watching and completed lists, and to pick up from the episode you stopped at.
auth.dataNote: We only receive your name, avatar and email. We never post on your behalf.
auth.agreeTo: By signing in you agree to the <link>privacy policy</link>.
auth.errorNotLinked: This email already signed in another way. Use the same service you used the first time.
auth.errorAccessDenied: Sign-in rejected. Your email may not be verified with the provider.
auth.errorVerification: The sign-in link expired. Please try again.
auth.errorGeneric: Could not sign in. Please try again.

footer.sources: Anime data comes from open sources: MyAnimeList, Shikimori, AniList. We do not host or serve any video.

import.intro: Bring your list over from Shikimori or MyAnimeList. Anything already in your list stays as it is — the import never overwrites.
import.malHint: MAL no longer exposes lists by username, so an export is needed: myanimelist.net/panel.php?go=export → “Export My List” → upload the downloaded file here.

error.failed: The source did not respond. Try again.

import.repeatHint: Titles missing from our catalog are pulled in automatically. One run does not always cover everything — just run the import again.

friends.title: Friends of the project
friends.note: Channels that helped spread the word about TokiWa. Thank you!

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Tell me what you like, what annoys you, and what's missing. This directly shapes what gets built next — and what gets removed.
feedback.done: Thanks! Every one of these gets read, honestly.

error.tooLong: Too long — keep it under 2000 characters.
error.tooMany: That's enough for today — up to 5 per day.

feedback.nudgeText: What works, what annoys you, what's missing — a couple of sentences help a lot.

wrapped.title: My anime in numbers
wrapped.intro: Everything your list has accumulated — in honest numbers.
wrapped.daysOfLife: ≈ {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of your life
wrapped.shareText: I've watched {hours} hours of anime — that's {days} days of my life 💀 Top genres: {genres}. Count yours: tokiwa.moe
wrapped.empty: Your list is empty — nothing to sum up yet.
wrapped.supportText: TokiWa is built by one person. If these numbers were fun, you can support the project — it keeps it running.

guest.saveTitle: Your list lives in this browser
guest.saveText: An account adds what a cookie can't: new-episode notifications for your shows, your list on any device — and it survives clearing your history.

moods.title: By mood
moods.intro: Not by genre or length, but by how you feel today.
moods.empty: Nothing here yet — check back later.

sad.name: Tearjerker
sad.tagline: When you need a good cry

tense.name: On edge
tense.tagline: Keeps you to the last episode

mind.name: Makes you think
mind.tagline: Heavy — and it stays with you

updates.title: What's new
updates.intro: The site ships almost daily — here's what you may have noticed.
updates.installIos: Tap Share at the bottom of Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”.
updates.installAndroid: Browser menu (⋮) → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

calendar.title: Episode calendar
calendar.intro: What airs this week. Titles from your list are marked.
calendar.empty: No dates for this week yet.

support.title: Support TokiWa
support.intro: The site is built by one person. It's free, ad-free and has no paid features — counting time and keeping lists stays open to everyone.
support.why: The domain, database and email cost money every month. Support covers the bills and buys time to build features instead of figuring out how to pay for them.
support.perk1: A ♥ badge next to your name on the site
support.perk2: Your name on the thanks page — if you want it there
support.perk3: Early access to new features before everyone else
support.perk4: A say in what comes next: supporters get asked first
support.honest: The project is two weeks old and supporters are few. Any amount helps, and a one-off tip is just as good as a subscription.
support.thanksEmpty: Names of those who supported the project will appear here.
